238.title: Ascent Group LLC Acquires 1,946 Shares of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
238.summary: Ascent Group LLC increased its stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 6.5% in the second quarter, acquiring an additional 1,946 shares, bringing their total holding to 32,004 shares valued at $18.6 million. Institutional investors collectively own 71.34% of AMD, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with a target price of $546.87, citing growth potential in AI accelerators and data centers. The company reported strong Q2 results with $1.66 adjusted EPS and $11.54 billion in revenue, and is planning a $5 billion bond offering to fund AI infrastructure expansion.

240.title: Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. Purchases 3,370 Shares of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
240.summary: Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. increased its stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 3.0% in Q2, acquiring 3,370 additional shares, bringing its total to 114,779 shares valued at $66.7 million. This move comes as institutional investors collectively own 71.34% of AMD, despite recent insider selling totaling $74.7 million. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with a target price of $546.87, following AMD's strong Q2 earnings which exceeded expectations with $1.66 EPS and $11.54 billion in revenue.

243.title: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) Trading 6.5% Higher - Time to Buy?
243.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares surged 6.5% to around $514 after Baird issued a bullish $1,250 price target, contributing to a "Moderate Buy" consensus among analysts. The company reported strong Q2 earnings with revenue up 50.1% year-over-year and exceeded EPS estimates, further bolstered by AI advancements and rising server-CPU demand forecasts. However, concerns remain regarding AMD's high valuation (P/E ratio of 132.23), a planned $4-5 billion bond offering, intense competition from Nvidia, and recent insider selling.

245.title: What's Going On With AMD Stock Friday?
245.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is planning a $5 billion bond offering to fund its aggressive expansion into AI and server markets. The company projects over 80% server revenue growth in the second half of 2026 and at least 70% in 2027, with its broader data-center business expected to grow well over 100% next year. AMD shares were up 0.52% in premarket trading following these announcements.

247.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) files automatic shelf for future debt securities
247.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has filed an automatic shelf registration (Form S-3ASR) as a well-known seasoned issuer, allowing it to offer and sell debt securities from time to time in future offerings. This filing creates the capacity for AMD to issue debt, with specific terms for each issuance to be detailed in separate prospectus supplements. The common stock of AMD trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "AMD," with a last reported sale price of $482.93 per share on August 12, 2026.

250.title: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD Holdings Lowered by City Holding Co.
250.summary: City Holding Co. has reduced its stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 6.8%, selling 1,362 shares but still retaining 18,571 shares valued at approximately $10.8 million. Despite institutional ownership of 71.34% and AMD exceeding quarterly expectations with earnings of $1.66 per share and revenue of $11.54 billion, concerns remain regarding the stock's valuation at a P/E ratio of 120.71 and significant insider selling. Analysts generally maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $546.87, while also noting positive sentiment around AMD's AI inference strategy and data-center expansion, balanced against risks of high valuation and execution.

254.title: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) Given Consensus Recommendation of "Moderate Buy" by Analysts
254.summary: Analysts have issued a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating for Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD), with an average 12-month price target of $546.87. This follows AMD's strong Q2 performance, which saw record revenue of $11.54 billion and adjusted EPS of $1.66, driven significantly by data center growth. Despite high expectations and a P/E ratio of 124.26, the company faces risks related to intense competition from Nvidia and the need for sustained AI growth execution.

257.title: AMD Stock tumbles because of SpaceX
257.summary: AMD reported its strongest quarter ever with record revenue and doubled data center sales, yet its stock fell by as much as 10%. This decline was largely attributed to SpaceX's announcement that it would exclusively use Nvidia chips for its AI infrastructure, including its upcoming Starmind AI1 satellites. This decision undermined AMD's efforts to position its chips as a viable alternative to Nvidia in the AI market, leading to concerns about AMD's growth narrative and concentration in the data center segment.

259.title: AMD Shares Fall 8% as Elon Musk Commits to Nvidia Chips for SpaceX
259.summary: AMD's shares dropped over 8% after Elon Musk announced that SpaceX would stop purchasing AMD chips, opting instead for Nvidia's. This occurred despite AMD reporting record quarterly sales, primarily driven by a doubling of data center chip sales, though revenue only slightly exceeded analyst estimates. The news highlighted a competitive shift in the chip market.

281.title: Core Scientific and AMD Announce Infrastructure Partnership
281.summary: Core Scientific and AMD have announced a partnership to develop AI infrastructure, with AMD securing up to 2.5 gigawatts of data center capacity from Core Scientific. This collaboration will support the deployment of AMD AI solutions, including Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs, and ROCm software, with initial capacity of over 500 megawatts starting in 2027. The agreement aims to address the rapidly accelerating demand for AI compute by expanding access to AI-ready infrastructure.

282.title: Advanced Micro Devices Inc (AMD) Stock Down 5.2% but Still Overvalued -- GF Score: 79/100
282.summary: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. (AMD) shares dropped 5.2% to $494.95, but the stock is still considered significantly overvalued with a GF Value™ of $245.59. Despite a strong GF Score™ of 79/100, which highlights solid financial strength and growth potential, its valuation score is very low (1/10). Insider selling of $147.1 million over the past three months, with no buying activity, further suggests caution for investors due to the current high valuation.
